title: Horace Henderson's Collegians at Wilberforce
summary: Horace Henderson's good band at Wilberforce included Freddie Jenkins, Rex Stewart and Benny Carter, and used so many of Fletcher's arrangements.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving

blocks.x: Oh, yes. Well, you know, I knew with Freddie Jenkins, you know, when he was Horace Henderson's Collegians in Wilberforce.

Horace Henderson had a good band in Wilberforce, and Rex Stewart was in that band down there. Bennie Carter played with that band and the trombone player that was with Jimmy Lunsford played with that band, too, played third trombone with Jimmy Lunsford.
Was he Jonah's cousin? Isn't that -- ?
I can't recall his name right now.
Yeah, I can't recall his name right away. But he was with that band, with Horace Henderson's band.
And he had a very good band. You know,

Horace played across from Fletcher in the Graystone Ballroom and he played so many of Fletcher's arrangements Fletcher didn't have anything left to play because Horace used to take all his brother's arrangements, you know. He used to take all his brother's arrangements.
Yes, he did. But that's where Freddie Jenkins came from.
